messages:
Luca (AE): Heads-up — Nimbus Finance needs a compliance bundle for the POC by next Tue: redacted SOC 2 report, ISO 27001 cert copy, pen-test attestation (signed), network diagram for staging, and cost delta for single-tenant staging + reg-data residency in eu-west. Also asked whether we can provide a sample pen-test letter up-front.

Priya (SE): We can pull a redacted SOC2 summary + control mapping. ISO cert copy should be fine. For pen-test, standard is a short attestation + summary; full vendor report requires NDA + legal approval.

Owen (Security): Agreed. Provide: 1) SOC2 redacted (attach control matrix), 2) ISO cert (PDF), 3) Pen-test attestation template + redacted findings summary. Remove exploit PoCs, CVE details, and any customer-specific IPs.

Marco (Infra): For single-tenant staging, estimate +$9k/mo on top of hosted plan for reserved GPUs + isolated network. Data residency (eu-west) is possible but adds config + egress cost; estimate 2-3 days ops work to spin up region + certs. On-prem connector is a separate timeline (approx 5-7 weeks).

Luca (AE): Thanks — will include pricing in the quote. Quick ask: can we give them an example pen-test letter now so they can approve wording?

Owen (Security): Yes, we have a short template. Will send below (Legal signoff required):

```
[Redwood Inference Letterhead]
Penetration Test Attestation
Date: YYYY-MM-DD
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference engaged [Third-party vendor] to perform a penetration test on our production environment scoped to [scope summary]. No critical or high-severity findings affecting data confidentiality or integrity were identified at the time of testing. A redacted summary of findings and remediation status is attached.
Sincerely,
Owen (Security)
Redwood Inference
```

Jo (Legal): I'll need to review the template and sign. If customer requests the full pentest report, they must sign an NDA and we will process via the DPA team. Send any full-report requests to legal@redwood.ai.

artifact-bot: Presigned upload created by Luca: https://storage.redwood.ai/presign/nimbus-poc-pack-xyz (expires in 72h) :package: 

Priya (SE): Action items: Priya to collate SOC2 extract + control mapping; Marco to confirm exact IP ranges and provide the staging network diagram; Owen to hand over signed attestation template to Jo; Luca to confirm customer accepts redacted pack.

Luca (AE): I'll confirm acceptance. One more thing — Nimbus asked if our Dedicated SLA covers per-route latency SLOs and can we provide a short one-pager.

Priya (SE): We have a Dedicated one-pager with SLOs and metrics. I'll attach to the presigned link. If they push for per-route SLOs that are tighter, we can propose a custom SLA (legal + finance approval needed).

Owen (Security): Reminder: redact any internal ticket IDs and do not include verbatim vulnerability PoCs. High-level remediation statuses only.

Marco (Infra): I'll drop the network diagram (PNG) and cost note into the presigned link once Luca confirms.

Luca (AE): Target upload = Mon AM so Nimbus can review Mon afternoon. If Legal needs more time for signature, I'll flag delay. Thanks team :)

Jo (Legal): I'll prioritize review. If they need the full report and sign NDA we'll route it through secure-share and record the access log.

Luca (AE): Great — will update thread with confirmation and presign link.
